def cobs_encode(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    n = len(data)
    if n == 0:
        return b"\x01"
    out = bytearray()
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        start = i
        while i < n and data[i] != 0:
            i += 1
        length = i - start
        zero_follows = i < n
        while length > 254:
            out.append(255)
            out.extend(data[start:start + 254])
            start += 254
            length -= 254
        if length == 254 and zero_follows:
            out.append(255)
            out.extend(data[start:start + 254])
            continue
        out.append(length + 1)
        out.extend(data[start:start + length])
        if zero_follows:
            i += 1
    if data[-1] == 0:
        out.append(1)
    return bytes(out)

def cobs_decode(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    data = bytes(data)
    if not data:
        raise ValueError("empty COBS input")
    if 0 in data:
        raise ValueError("zero byte in COBS input")
    out = bytearray()
    i = 0
    n = len(data)
    while i < n:
        code = data[i]
        i += 1
        count = code - 1
        if i + count > n:
            raise ValueError("COBS group runs past end")
        out.extend(data[i:i + count])
        i += count
        if code != 255 and i < n:
            out.append(0)
    if cobs_encode(out) != data:
        raise ValueError("invalid COBS input")
    return bytes(out)
